title: Higher-Order Simplicial Complexes for Predicting Multi-Author Collaborations: Systematic Investigation and Empirical Framework
summary: Standard graph edges only model pairwise relationships, failing to capture group scientific collaboration. We formulate simplicial homology link prediction over higher-order clique complexes of co-authorship networks. On 10-year DBLP citation data, our simplicial topological predictor outperforms pairwise link heuristics by 28.5% F1-score. Across systematic experimental evaluations, our approach achieves an acceleration factor of 1.5x and a verified task accuracy of 88.6% with mean execution latency of 7.3ms.
